principles: No gradients for gradients' sake - meaningful data visualization only.
High contrast for readability (WCAG AA compliant).
Motion is functional (loading states, transitions), not decorative.
Data density is a feature, not a bug.

headings.usage: Page titles, Section headers, Key Metrics

buttons.primary: bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-md shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(99,102,241,0.3)] font-medium px-6 py-2 transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700 rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-all

inputs.style: bg-slate-950 border-slate-800 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500 rounded-md text-lg p-4 placeholder:text-slate-600
inputs.hero_input: h-16 text-2xl bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-md border-slate-700 focus:border-indigo-400 rounded-lg w-full max-w-2xl shadow-2xl

landing_page.structure: Centered Hero with floating input. Subtle animated background grid.
landing_page.alignment: Center-aligned content, left-aligned features below fold.

processing_page.structure: Vertical Split: Left side Timeline (The 8 Steps), Right side 'Console Log' or 'Detail View'.
processing_page.animation: Staggered reveal of steps. Active step pulses.

results_page.structure: Dashboard Grid (Bento). Top Bar: Ticker & Rec. Main area: Tabs for Thesis, Valuation, etc.

visual_enhancers.gradients: Radial gradient at top-center: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(99,102,241,0.15) 0%, transparent 50%)

motion.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}

hero_background.usage: Hero section background with heavy dark overlay (opacity 0.8-0.9)

admin_bg.usage: Subtle background for admin or login pages

landing: Use the 'hero_input' style for the main ticker box.
Include a 'Recent Searches' or 'Trending Tickers' pill list below the input.
Use the 'hero_background' image with a very dark overlay (bg-slate-950/90) to ensure text readability.
processing: The 8-step pipeline is the Hero. Make it look like a system check.
Steps: 1. Initializing, 2. Fetching Data, 3. Analyzing 10-K, 4. Formatting Financials, 5. Calculating Ratios, 6. Drafting Thesis, 7. Building Model, 8. Finalizing.
Use a progress bar at the top fixed position.
results: Recommendation Box: MUST use the color codes (Green/Buy, Red/Sell, Amber/Hold). Large font.
Tabs: Use Shadcn Tabs but style them to look like segmented controls or minimal underlines.
Model Preview: Use a dense grid to mimic Excel. Monospace font for numbers is critical.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Space Grotesk'.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states (text color change or bg change).
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons and inputs.
For financial numbers, always align right.
